title: Marionette: Predicting World States, Rendering Geometry, Painting Appearance
abstract: arXiv:2608.14530v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interactive game world models typically autoregress visual observations directly in pixel or latent space, forcing structured properties such as pose, geometry, and occlusion to be implicitly maintained by the same generative sequence. Over long horizons, errors in these latent world properties accumulate, making consistency and controllability fragile. We explicitly model the evolving world state, delegate exact geometric computation to a fixed, zero-parameter renderer, and leave the neural model to synthesize appearance. We instantiate this idea as Marionette, a world model for interactive games with articulated characters. translated_title: 木偶：预测世界状态、渲染几何、绘制外观
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14530v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：交互式游戏世界模型通常直接在像素或潜在空间中进行自回归视觉观察，迫使姿态、几何和遮挡等结构化属性由同一生成序列隐式维护。在长时间跨度内，这些潜在世界属性的误差会累积，使一致性和可控性变得脆弱。我们显式建模不断演化的世界状态，将精确的几何计算委托给固定的、零参数的渲染器，并让神经模型负责合成外观。我们将这一想法实现为Marionette，一个用于具有关节角色的交互式游戏的世界模型。首先，一个两阶段自回归动力学模型预测一个显式且可解释的276维三维世界状态，包括多实体关节骨架、度量根轨迹和旋转。其次，一个零参数图形桥将预测状态转换为姿态控制视频，计算遮挡和深度。
tldr: 本文提出Marionette，通过显式预测可解释的三维世界状态并委托零参数渲染器处理几何，显著提升了长时距游戏世界模型的稳定性和可控性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Marionette, which explicitly predicts interpretable 3D world states and delegates geometry to a zero-parameter renderer, significantly improving stability and controllability of long-horizon game world models.
